Jack Heart asked "what are Shift and Shifted in the examples?" (examples/agent_game.py, release notes). They read as unexplained toys. In user-facing docs, examples and release notes, replace them with a wrapper a reader recognizes, e.g. a Sampled/Greedy player record (temperature field) and the object build returns from it, saying in one line that the record is the declared player (its identity) and the built object is what play calls. Tests may keep a minimal toy if named for what it does.
